registry.toolCheckinDesc: Scheduled third-party check-in driven by site descriptors: date-based idempotency, credentials encrypted on disk, honest result reporting

checkin.title: Auto Check-in
checkin.subtitle: Calls third-party check-in endpoints on a schedule. No endpoint is hardcoded — a site descriptor below decides what to send and how to read the status; when a descriptor is invalid the tool sends nothing at all.
checkin.fixErrors: The descriptor has errors — fix them below first
checkin.empty: No sites yet. Click “Add site” and paste in the request you captured from devtools.
checkin.autostartHint: Scheduling depends on the app staying resident: closing the main window only minimizes it to the tray, but quitting the app (including the tray “Quit” item) stops it. For truly unattended runs, keep launch-at-startup on.
checkin.autostartFailed: Could not change launch at startup
checkin.toastBadDescriptor: {n} site descriptor(s) are invalid and were skipped (no request sent)

err.descriptorNotObject: a site descriptor must be a JSON object
err.keyInvalid: use lowercase letters, digits, underscore or hyphen, starting with a letter or digit
err.keyDuplicate: this key is already taken by another site
err.urlNotHttps: https is required (plain http hands your login state to anyone on the path)
err.urlHasQueryOrHash: baseUrl must not carry a query string or hash
err.credentialSourceUnknown: no such credential source (only qoder-cn-local exists); leave it unset to send the credentials written in headers
err.pathProtocolRelative: must not start with // (that replaces the whole host)
err.pathControlChar: no line breaks or carriage returns in the path
err.pathSyntax: bad value path — e.g. data.checkedToday or data.items[0].points
err.pathFromNotObject: pathFrom must be an object: keys are placeholder names, values are selectors
err.pathFromNameInvalid: placeholder name has illegal characters (letters, digits, _ - $ only)
err.pathFromSelectorInvalid: a selector is either a dot path, or an object with path / where / pick fields
err.pathFromWhereInvalid: where must be an object whose values are primitives (compared strictly)
err.pathFromWithoutStatus: pathFrom requires a status action — that response is where the value comes from
err.placeholderMissing: this placeholder has no pathFrom selector — check the field name
err.placeholderUnused: a pathFrom selector is declared but never used in the path — check the field name
err.selectorNotArray: the selector does not point at an array
err.selectorNoMatch: no element matched the condition in the response
err.valueMissing: that field is missing or empty in the response
err.valueUnsafe: the extracted value contains characters not allowed in a URL
err.methodNotAllowed: only GET / POST / PUT are allowed
err.bodyNotAllowed: a GET request cannot carry a body
err.headerValueControlChar: no line breaks or carriage returns in a header value
err.actionNotObject: an action must be an object
